newsitem.title: USA: Dlr sets new peak vs mark, hurdles 115 yen in US.
newsitem.headline: Dlr sets new peak vs mark, hurdles 115 yen in US.

text.p: *Dlr/mark pops to another fresh 71-month high of 1.8020 in US morning then retreats again. Dlr/yen jumps above 115 to day high of 115, seen having more legs than dollar/mark.
*Intervention jitters cloud dollar/mark trade, rate seen vulnerable to profit-taking, but good buy interest at 1.79.
*US retail sales up 0.5 pct June, dollar impact negligible.
